sources: Hit structure, keys and frames: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0036_jsspsi_* (game 1.6). Battle skill, combo and ultimate hits come from ability entities (*_abilityrange*) spawned by the skill; their frames are the spawn frame plus the entity's own DamageAction frames. Values: SkillPatchTable, potentials from PotentialTalentEffectTable (P3 ×1.2 ultimate atk_scale/atk_scale_2/enhance_final, P5 ×1.15 combo atk_scale/atk_scale2/atk_scale2_1 and +1 stack).

Battle skill hit (normal_skill_abilityrange_1 = atk_scale) matches exactly in fixtures zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 (P5), zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f (P5) and zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8 (P1). In 40d9a3c1da37 every Si hit was 3.83% low until her build there was given attributeNodes 2: nodes chr_0036_jsspsi_5 and _7 (+15 and +20 Wisd, her main attribute) need trust 300, which the log doesn't record; with them off, battle skill, basic attack and ultimate hits there all match exactly.

Basic attack 2 matches in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f under Arcane's Corrosion (level 2, 1 tick). Basic attack 1 (both hits) matches in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 and at 0.68 s into Corrosion in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f; basic attacks 1, 3, 4 aren't mapped to log events because two of their hits in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f sit just past a whole second of Corrosion while showing one tick fewer (ZMDLogs timestamps fall on a ~110 ms grid, so a hit can be logged up to ~0.11 s late; the log check doesn't allow for that yet). Corrosion ticks there run on the enemy's time: 0 ticks at 0.68/1.03 s, 1 at 1.47/2.04 s, 2 at 2.39/2.50 s and still 2 at 4.19 s after three combo casts (each with a 0.8 s time dilation) at 3.53 s, 3 from 4.32 s.

Ultimate: the 8 atk_scale hits and the atk_scale_2 hit all match in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 (P3 ×1.2, under the ultimate's own amp, which the log lists) and the 8 atk_scale hits in zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8 (P1, no ×1.2). Not mapped to log events because both hit kinds share one event key (the log check maps an event to the first kit hit) and because zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8 logs some of them seconds late, under the wrong buffs.

Combo: the 10 atk_scale hits (P5 ×1.15) match exactly in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 only with +100% DMG bonus the log doesn't list: Jade Vessel (wpn_claym_0018) skill 3 combo_dmg_up 0.6 at level 8 (buff_wpn_claym_0018_normal_skill_comboimbue_atk, after a battle skill) + Type 50 Yinglung set (buff_equipsuit_atk_02_addcombodamage_buff) 0.2 per stack, one stack per team battle-skill cast since the wearer's last combo (max_stack 3), here 2 stacks; and in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f with +130% = 0.7 (skill 3 level 9) + 3 stacks, all 10 hits exact once the log's buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_enemy_debuff is dropped (its damageModifier needs decorate mask 33554432 and a slowed target, so it doesn't apply to Si) and Corrosion level 2 has 2 ticks at 4.19 s and 3 from 4.32 s. Not mapped to log events until the engine models both bonuses.

skills.label: Battle skill (Artful Intent)
skills.note: durationFrame 168; Battle Skill Move 2 (normal_skill_1, 15 SP) allowed from frame 34. Applies Artful Intent (buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_xianjing_inkhurteffect): while it lasts, ink_damage_rate (0.13 at level 12, +0.07 at P1) of all damage the target takes is recorded, and its burst (Move 3 = normal_skill_2, or expiry) deals that total as Fixed DMG, logged as chr_0036_jsspsi_normal_skill_inkmove_2 (damageType 8, element null). Not in the kit: it needs a damage-record mechanic. Logged bursts are 0.1998 × (all damage after the battle-skill hit until the burst) in zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 and 0.1980 in zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f (both P5, rate 0.20).

skills.label: Combo skill
skills.note: durationFrame 228; battle skill allowed from frame 20; time dilation (curve ComboSkill) for 0.8 s from frame 0. Entity chr_0036_jsspsi_combo_skill_abilityrange spawned at frame 0. Final hit not in the kit: its multiplier is atk_scale2 + n × atk_scale2_1, where n is the number of Cryo/Heat infliction stacks consumed or absorbed to trigger the combo (+1 at P5); kits can only multiply keys. Verified by hand: zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37 t=14737 = 18.75 × the slash hit ×1.5 crit, i.e. 4.025 + 4 × 1.15 = 8.625 (n = 3, +1 at P5; the same cast's buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_combo_potential2 ATK +0.2 = 0.08 + 0.03 × 4 agrees); zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f t=9331 = 4.025 + 3 × 1.15 with crit and one more Corrosion tick (±1). The combo also gives P2's ATK buff (0.08 + 0.03 × stacks, 10 s), which logs list.

Entity chr_0036_jsspsi_ultimate_skill_abilityrange_1 (fail branch of a CheckMainCharacterCondition; the one every fixture logs) or _abilityrange (succeed branch; same hit timeline) spawned at frame 0. At frame 62 it gives the team buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_atk_buff_2: Cryo and Heat Amp = enhance_final (0.36 at level 12, ×1.2 at P3 = 0.432) for enhance_duration (12 s); every ultimate hit lands under it. Not a kit condition (its value is a skill value, not a talent's or weapon's).
